# Hi, I'm Jacob! 

![](profile_picture.jpg){fig-align="left" width=250}

I have an undergraduate physics degree from [Columbia University's School of Engineering and Applied Science (SEAS)](https://www.engineering.columbia.edu/home-eng).

I build scientific software and hardware.
Most recently I was a Research Assistant at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, developing the data reduction pipeline for a space-based telescope. 
Before that, I spent two years an optics lab at the University of Arizona.
Check out my [projects](projects.qmd) for more information.
